subject: Focused re-test request and exploit trace logs — MeridianHealth
messages:
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@meridianhealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: RedShield PenTest <eng@redshield.io>
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: focused re-test and exploit traces for Meridian Health pentest

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the remediation guidance on the recent pentest. Meridian would like to request a focused re-test on two confirmed post-remediation items from the March 1 report (high/medium findings). Specifically: CVE-2027-1421 (auth bypass, web app) and the session fixation vector discovered on the API gateway.

Can RedShield run a narrow re-test limited to the affected endpoints and provide:
- exploit repro steps executed during validation (safe playback / non-destructive),
- packet captures or application trace logs from the re-test run, and
- a one-page delta attestation we can include in our SOC2 evidence package.

We'd like the testing window to be the week of Mar 20–24, preferably in the US PDX region. Meridian will provide temporary test accounts and the remediation checklist you asked for.

Attached: Meridian_PT_Report_v1.pdf (original report excerpt).

Appreciate a quick confirmation and any scheduling constraints.

Best,
Alex Taylor
Security Engineering Manager
Meridian Health

---
Attachment: Meridian_PT_Report_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@meridianhealth.com>, RedShield PenTest <eng@redshield.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: focused re-test and exploit traces for Meridian Health pentest

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. RedShield, are you able to confirm availability for the Mar 20–24 window and the specific deliverables (exploit trace, pcap, delta attestation)?

Vivek / Marissa — looping you both in. Action items for Redwood:
- Confirm network/egress allowlist for the test IPs (we'll share the IP range with Meridian).
- Collect and attach remediation artifacts Meridian requested (remediation_checklist.xlsx).
- Coordinate a short kickoff call (15–20 min) the week prior to align scope and safe testing rules.

Alex — can you drop the temporary test account details and the list of endpoints in a doc link? If easier, paste the minimal scope into a reply and we'll pull it into our scheduling flow.

Thanks,
Aisha
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: remediation_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@meridianhealth.com>, RedShield PenTest <eng@redshield.io>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: focused re-test and exploit traces for Meridian Health pentest

Alex / RedShield — quick update from our side. We have: 
- Uploaded a scoped endpoint list to the shared Drive (link below).
- Prepared a remediation packet with configuration diffs and patch notes.
- Can support the Mar 21 13:00–16:00 PDT slot for active validation.

Proposed test limits: 
- IP range: 35.188.120.10-35.188.120.20 (RedShield VPN will be whitelisted).
- Timeboxed to 3 hours per target, non-destructive verification only.
- RedShield to provide raw pcap + application traces and a short delta attestation doc within 3 business days of test completion.

Attachments: meridian_retest_scope.json (scope manifest), remediation_checklist.xlsx (evidence).

Jonas — please confirm the observability hooks we'll share (request-id headers, sample log lines) so RedShield can correlate traces back to request flows.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Security
Redwood Inference

---
Shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/meridian/retest-evidence
From: RedShield PenTest <eng@redshield.io>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: focused re-test and exploit traces for Meridian Health pentest

Thanks all — RedShield confirms the Mar 21, 13:00–16:00 PDT window and accepts the proposed test limits. We will: 
- Run focused validation against the two findings you noted (CVE-2027-1421, session fixation path).
- Provide non-destructive exploit playbacks, packet captures, and application trace exports.
- Produce a short signed delta attestation (PDF) describing tools used, test steps executed, and validation result; delivery within 72 hours after the run.

Please ensure the whitelisted IPs are in place by EOD Mar 20 and share the temporary test account credentials via the secure vault link. We'll use the request-id header mapping Vivek mentioned to align traces.

Looking forward — we'll upload artifacts to the shared drive and mark the attestation as restricted access for SOC2 evidence.

Best,
Samir Patel
Test Lead, RedShield PenTest
eng@redshield.io

---
Referenced attachments (post-run): exploit_playback.log (txt), meridian_retest_pcap.pcap (pcap), delta_attestation_signed.pdf (pdf)
